source_bodies: Real NumPy ufuncs/outer and Python sorted(set)
mathematical_boundary: Only elementary asinh/sinh/log10/ln/integer power primitives replaced by independent exact-input Decimal180/320 and Fraction calculations. Both complete original AST runs are retained. Numeric ascending/first-sourcezero/individual NaNs-last is explicit deterministic profile; source NaN hash order is recorded as stable multiset, never as a unique order.

cpp_arange_length_evidence.semantic_boundary: C source evidence: exact Python stop-start, Python true divide by1 yields float, then ceil-to-intp. Large-count sample AST probes replace only arange allocation; they are not full-array observations.

source_nan_nondeterminism_evidence.scope: Historical fixed-runtime readonly observations in D26-asinh-grid-notes; counts are evidence, not exhaustive or stable platform guarantees.
